claims.text: Variate-token transformers show positive transfer across domains on ETTh1, Traffic, Exchange.
iTransformer is best characterised as inverted transformer treating variates as tokens.

evidence.description: iTransformer pretrained on Electricity yields a 17% MSE reduction over random init when fine-tuned on ETTh1.

methodologies.name: iTransformer
methodologies.description: inverted transformer treating variates as tokens

limitations.text: Hyperparameters are tuned per-dataset, which advantages larger models that can absorb the added capacity.
Attention weights are not analysed, leaving the interpretability claims unverified.

future_work.text: Reporting per-seed variance and confidence intervals for the headline metric.
